author: Juan Majano
text:
In my opinion, one of the best restaurants in the entire DVM. The service, atmosphere, and food were 10/10.
Our favorite waiter, Alejandro, always had the best attitude and gave the best recommendations for the menu and bar.
The manager, Steven, visited our table several times to make sure everything was alright.
Thank you, guys, for the outstanding service!

author: George Ju
text:
We hosted a large group event here for our kids' sports team (20+ people!) and it was a great experience from start to finish. The reservation process was quick and easy, and they set up a dedicated space for us on the outdoor patio that worked perfectly for our group.  There was music, but it wasn't too loud, so it created ambiance without drowning out conversations.

The staff was friendly and our servers were attentive throughout, even with such a large party. The food was excellent!  Everything came out hot and fresh with really authentic flavors. The fresh chips and salsa were a hit, and the drinks were unique and well made.

Huge plus: our server, Emil, was able to split checks by family, which made managing orders and payments for such a large group so much easier.  The ambiance was casual and fun, which was perfect for a group setting.

Shout out goes to Emil, Estefania, and the staff for the excellent service!  Highly recommend Señor Tequila's for families and larger group events!

author: Dee Williams
text: First time here and so amazing - from service, to food and atmosphere… Was a big milestone birthday for me and took a chance to try somewhere new…So glad we did Senor Tequilas did not disappoint.  Orlando our server was polite and personable, with attention to detail.  Knowing it was my special day, he took care of us with prompt service and grace.  We ordered to fajitas with flank steak, shrimp, and chicken.  Very generous portions resulting in leftovers for both my husband and I.  We also got the fried ice cream which was ridiculously good and I am not one for sweets but would definitely get this again.  Thank you Orlando for making it a memorable experience on all fronts.  We will definitely be back and wouldn’t want anyone else to serve us but you.  Thank you!!!

author: Madison Wright
text: Mari was our server and she was awesome!! We went here for a last minute birthday dinner and had a great time. The mariachi band is always so fun for birthdays. Their drinks are amazing as well & I highly recommend the virgin mango daiquiri!!

author: Roger Thomas
text: We dropped in for lunch while passing through, and found the food tasty, the service prompt, and the prices reasonable. The Happy Hour menu (opening through 5:00pm) is quite reasonable, but they also had more exotic menu items. The birilla tacos were tasty and just the right portion size.

author: Erick Cruz
text: We celebrated our grandmother's birthday; the food was delicious, the atmosphere was lovely, and at the end, along with the desserts, everyone sang "Happy Birthday." Thank you to Alejandro for his service.
